purpose: Verify ROM cold boot, long-duration behavior, and precision against independent evidence for paths used by G2
existing_v3_status: 16/16 fixed functional criteria; not inherited as fidelity completion
progress_rule: Each area weight / 5 × number of conditions with verified evidence. New conditions are not yet evaluated. All 25 conditions must pass for overall completion.
long_run_compute_hours: unknown until measured wall/virtual ratio per workload
external_asset_wait: unknown; exact ROM and independent GAF/GPU oracle can block completion indefinitely

criteria.acceptance: Pin provenance and compatibility scope of exact Boot ROM/bootloader/main and initial state. Do not replace unavailable images with dummies.

Observe actual initialization, verification, and handoff from original bootloader reset and connect to main without forcing branches, returns, or TCB. Distinguish results using a functional ROM API model from actual ROM execution.
Execute continuously from actual Boot ROM reset through original bootloader/main/UI. Reject paths replacing required ROM/security effects with success stubs.
Pin allowed reset/update states and invalid image/verification failure inputs; assess original errors, blocking, and return outcomes. Do not install on physical hardware.
Preserve cold-boot lineage/state and execution and new-environment reproduction for three originals/registered candidate, and check that ROM/bootloader are unmodified.
Measure bounded resources, progress/normal idle, intentional fault detection, and wall/virtual cost per workload for long-duration observation.
For each of three originals, maintain six virtual seconds after first screen in two cold runs without fault/unknown/overflow, and assess original task, input, UI progress and normal waiting.
For each of three originals, verify 60 virtual seconds after first screen, repeated input, sensors, and disconnects in pinned scenarios across two cold runs.
Compare stock24 and registered CFW candidate on the same workload for 10 virtual minutes with three pinned seeds; check resource/queue/IRQ/response, screen, and failure regressions.

For each of three originals and three pinned seeds, run one virtual hour after cold boot and verify normal idle/input response, resource trends, original termination state, reproducibility, and absence of errors.

Before execution, pin the supported command/shader/format corpus for three G2 originals/candidate and independent pixel ground truth, provenance, and tolerance. Absence of a physical reference leaves this incomplete.
Distinguishing inputs and boundaries for coverage, clip, blend, sampling, half-pixel, nibble, packing, and quantization match the relevant independent oracle.
Compare effects and ordering of original command submission → DMA/cache/IRQ/completion, reset, and invalid inputs against independent evidence.
For the pinned corpus, actual ARM-generated lists from three originals/CFW → guest framebuffer match independent ground truth; functional reference assumptions alone do not constitute a pass.
Detect accuracy/memory/IRQ/error regressions in a long-duration mixed workload and leave unsupported opcodes as explicit failures.
Pin exact sensor/patch/initial calibration state, input time series, independent GAF output, and units/timing/tolerances. Do not count raw FIFO/host API as fusion ground truth.
Match GAF initialization/requests 2 and 4/calibration/ready and numerical state effects to exact implementation/specification/independent output.
Compare quaternion/bias/accuracy/timestamp during stillness, rotation, acceleration, and magnetic disturbance against independent output and predetermined tolerances.
Verify output/state for reset, recalibration, drop/overflow, time changes, and long-duration drift against independent evidence.
Verify original main sensor configuration → FIFO/IRQ → task consumption → fusion-dependent behavior and long-duration integration; do not claim substitute AHRS/fixtures are exact GAF.
Pin G2-used peripherals, registers/state machines, accuracy grades, independent evidence, and unsupported list. Unknown required items are not complete.
Verify clock/timer/IRQ priorities, power/reset/retention/cache lifecycle, and tolerances against independent evidence. Cycle and power accuracy are excluded.
Verify ordering, asynchronous side effects, and error/buffer boundaries for IOM/SPI/UART/DMA/FIFO/GPIO and required touch/auxiliary sensors/peer transport.
Compare original storage program/erase/busy/failure/interruption/post-reset reads against independent evidence within the pinned actual-use scope.

Integrate device contracts required by ROM cold boot and long-duration three-original/CFW scenarios; reproduce comparison, failure-cause, and new-environment reports without automatic ACK/ready for unknowns.
